notes.title: The cursor off bug fixed!
notes.content:
Hi

We've fixed the bug with cursor off issue. So you can play in any resolution which you like. We've has made this patch live a week ago, but the updated the unity and this update has broke everything. So we are spent a lot of time with post game objects to new framework.

If you have any other type of issue, then please share with us with a player log and screenshots/video (better video). And we will try to help you. 

output_log.txt you can find in folder Steam\steamapps\common\The Legions of Rome\game_Data 

Email: tambourine.company@gmail.com 

Sincerely, 
The Tambourine Team

notes.title: If you found a bug or want to offer something to us.
notes.content:
Hi

If you want to ask something about the gameplay, then create a thread on steam discussions.

If you found a bug, which can't keep you playing, then sent output_log.txt to us, which you can find in Steam\steamapps\common\The Legions of Rome\game_Data folder to the email.

If you want to share something or receive our game for review, then also send hi to email. But please don't waste your and our time and don't sent requests if you don't have a group in social networks or youtube channel.

For Groupees buyers. We are sent keys to Cyanic, so you are will be can play when he will upload it to website.

Email: tambourine.company@gmail.com

Sincerely,
The Tambourine Team
